title: Fused Maker (FusedAuto): a tool for summing and averaging repeated CT series
description:
Fused Maker (FusedAuto) sums or averages CT series acquired repeatedly at the same position, slice by slice, and saves the result as a new DICOM series. Series whose frame of reference, slice positions, matrix or slice count do not match are excluded automatically.

For research and education use only. Not for clinical use. Free for noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; please cite this record when you use the software in published research.

The Windows executable (FusedAuto.exe) and the user manuals (Japanese / English) are distributed on the GitHub Releases page: https://github.com/ryusei-inamori/FusedMaker/releases . This Zenodo record archives the source code of each release.
